note: Expanded LOGO: the atlas evaluation used 19 endolysins/12 genomes and 15 spanins/9 genomes, which left every model comparison inside its confidence interval. This uses all annotated lysis genes in the scanned panel. Protocol and negative recipes are unchanged from scripts/22 and scripts/28, so the figures describe the models as deployed.
